name: Gabriel India Ltd
about: Gabriel India is part of ANAND Group. The Company has established a significant presence across all automotive customer segments, including OEMs, Aftermarket, and exports. Company manufactures over 500 models of ride control products. [1] Its products include shock absorbers, struts, front forks and others.[2]
keyPoints: Business Overview:[1] Gabriel India is the flagship company of the ANAND Group. It started in ride control and now makes shock absorbers, struts, front forks, sunroofs, drivetrain products, NVH and Body-in-White parts, synchroniser rings, aluminium forgings, and automotive fluids and lubricants. Ride control products serve 2W/3W, PVs, CVs and railways. The company has 80+ R&D specialists and 3 technology centres across India and Europe.
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 32.9% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 30.8%
Promoter holding has increased by 2.74% over last quarter.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 37.5 days to 28.3 days
cons: Stock is trading at 8.44 times its book value
